# A .proto is one of the project's own files, read through the project: a
# path outside it is refused before anything is read, and so is an import of
# one. An import is read from the named file's directory, or else from the
# import root, as `protoc -I <dir> -I .` would; one found in neither is
# refused naming both. A file protobuf ships is its own.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off

! sngl check proj/up.sngl
stderr 'import "grpc:../outside/secret.proto": scheme "grpc": grpc:../outside/secret.proto is outside the project'

! sngl check proj/imports.sngl
stderr 'import "grpc:./imports.proto": .*imports.proto imports other.proto, and there is no ./other.proto or other.proto'

! sngl check proj/escape.sngl
stderr 'import "grpc:./escape.proto": .*escape.proto imports ../outside/secret.proto, which is outside the project'

sngl check proj/split.sngl

! sngl check proj/broken.sngl
stderr 'import "grpc:./broken.proto": .*broken.proto:2:9'

sngl check proj/wkt.sngl

-- proj/up.sngl --
import api "grpc:../outside/secret.proto"

const x = 1
-- proj/imports.sngl --
import api "grpc:./imports.proto"

const x = 1
-- proj/imports.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
import "other.proto";
-- proj/escape.sngl --
import api "grpc:./escape.proto"

const x = 1
-- proj/escape.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
import "../outside/secret.proto";
-- proj/split.sngl --
import api "grpc:./protos/library.proto"

// Shelf is beside library.proto, and Loan under the import root, each in a
// package of its own; both are reached, so both are written.
const x = api.Book{shelf=api.Shelf{name="A"}, loan=api.Loan{to="Ada"}}
-- proj/protos/library.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package library.v1;
import "shelf.proto";
import "loans/loan.proto";
message Book {
  shelf.v1.Shelf shelf = 1;
  loans.v1.Loan loan = 2;
}
-- proj/protos/shelf.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package shelf.v1;
import "loans/loan.proto";
message Shelf {
  string name = 1;
  repeated loans.v1.Loan out = 2;
}
-- proj/loans/loan.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
package loans.v1;
message Loan {
  string to = 1;
}
-- proj/broken.sngl --
import api "grpc:./broken.proto"

const x = 1
-- proj/broken.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
message {
-- proj/wkt.sngl --
import api "grpc:./wkt.proto"

const x = api.Stamp{}
-- proj/wkt.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";
message Stamp {
  google.protobuf.Timestamp at = 1;
}
-- outside/secret.proto --
syntax = "proto3";
